summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Job Time Tracking feature and AI Tools for SignGuy AI. All backend APIs (14 tests) and frontend UI flows tested successfully.

issues: Minor HTML nesting warning: div inside p tag in active timer display (causes hydration warning in console but doesn't affect functionality)

start_timer.backend: POST /api/jobs/{id}/time/start returns 200, creates entry with task_type and description
start_timer.frontend: Start Timer button works, timer display shows running time (00:00:01 format), toast 'Timer started!' appears

stop_timer.backend: POST /api/jobs/{id}/time/stop returns 200, calculates duration_minutes and labor_cost
stop_timer.frontend: Stop Timer button works, timer stops, toast 'Timer stopped!' appears, entry moves to log

view_entries.backend: GET /api/jobs/{id}/time returns list of entries with all fields
view_entries.frontend: Time Log section shows entries with task type badge, employee name, duration, timestamps, delete button

view_summary.backend: GET /api/jobs/{id}/time/summary returns total_hours, total_labor_cost, entries_count, by_employee, by_task_type
view_summary.frontend: Summary panel shows Total Time (hours), Labor Cost ($), Entries count

delete_entry.frontend: Delete button (trash icon) on entries removes entry from list

task_type_dropdown.backend: All task types work: design, production, installation, admin
task_type_dropdown.frontend: Dropdown shows options: Design, Production, Installation, Admin/Other

active_timer_check.backend: GET /api/jobs/{id}/time/active returns has_active_timer boolean and entry if active
active_timer_check.frontend: Active timer displays with green background, running time, and Active badge

duplicate_timer_prevention.backend: Returns 400 'You already have an active timer on this job' when trying to start second timer
duplicate_timer_prevention.frontend: Not directly tested but backend enforcement works

tagline_generator.backend: POST /api/ai/generate with tool='tagline_generator' returns content with taglines
tagline_generator.frontend: Tool accessible in AI Tools Suite > Branding category

font_identifier.backend: POST /api/ai/generate with tool='font_identifier' returns font analysis content
font_identifier.frontend: Tool shows image upload area, text sample input, Generate button, History section shows previous usage

ai_pricing_advisor.backend: POST /api/ai/generate with tool='pricing_advisor' returns pricing recommendations
ai_pricing_advisor.frontend: Visible in Pricing Calculator below breakdown, 'Get Suggestions' button triggers AI analysis (shows 'Analyzing...' state)

ai_history.backend: GET /api/ai/history returns list of previous AI generations
ai_history.frontend: History button in AI Tools shows previous tool usage

pricing_calculator.details: Categories work (Cut Vinyl tested), complexity slider (1-10), pricing breakdown shows Material/Labor/Setup costs, Suggested Price and Profit displayed

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: HTML nesting warning in Jobs.js line ~1040 - Badge (div) rendered inside p tag causing hydration warning. Consider wrapping Badge in span instead of p.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test time entries (TEST_TimeEntry, Playwright UI Test) during testing - cleaned up automatically by delete tests
